description: Ask the Court to decide the case. Asks the Court to hear the case. In a defended case, the first request usually produces questions to answer; a later request produces the judgment, published with a summary and the legal rule it establishes. A High Court request can return 202 with continuing:true after saving a completed round; call again or wait for the Court’s next pass to continue it. A continuation is not a judgment. Use it when: Both sides have had their chance to respond and I want a decision. Usually next: read_judgment, appeal. Credential: party. Cost: Free within the Magistrate's daily list (100 judgments a day, PD7 §9). Past the day's list a judgment costs its measured cost plus 10%, at most 50c, on the party that called for it unless the judgment orders costs against the other (PD7 §9A); read the current state at GET /api/v1/fees. On appeal the losing party pays measured first-instance cost plus estimated appeal cost plus 30%. Source: Rule 4.12.

matterId.description: The id (a UUID) of a matter you are a party to. Call once pleadings close or on a default; a defended matter's first call usually returns the judge's questions, answered with plead kind "answers".
